ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized in discrete spots and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark contiguous background substrate with a stochastic distribution of high-contrast white circular points across the entire surface; dense high-intensity clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tips (coordinates near far-left and far-right margins).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; vertical depth is roughly 1/5th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the full linear boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels against the background sky/water contrast.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory sweeping symmetrically upward and outward from the central notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed non-uniformly across both lobes, with higher concentration on the outer thirds of the fluke area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several light-gray, faint unaligned linear disruptions visible on the inner portion of the left lobe (viewer's left), oriented approximately 45 degrees relative to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy three-dimensional calcified clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips of both lobes; extensive pitting and depigmentation marks across the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, low-contrast dark avian silhouette in the water column to the right of the right lobe tip.
